description: Pack jsonx: JSON tools for aos configuration files that use $ref/$env - jsonx_get, jsonx_ls, jsonx_search, jsonx_set, jsonx_add, jsonx_del, jsonx_multi_get, jsonx_multi_set (follow, resolve, text, from, check options). The agent-fsm and eca-claude templates stack it (the eca subagent set tools_sub.json does not).
